finding.description: The recorded daily pinball metric averages every source date with at least one scored row. The frozen protocol requires equal averaging only over dates with at least 18 scored hourly anchors for the relevant horizon.
finding.known_validation_effect: The raw campaign reports 52 or 53 scored dates by horizon; the protocol-eligible validation count is 50 dates per horizon.
finding.training_or_prediction_impact: None. Model updates, final-only checkpoints and saved row predictions do not depend on this aggregation.
